page.title: Show me: work with the answer
page.description: Show me is a skill for coding agents: useful views inside the conversation, with your edits returned to the current task.
page.heading: Work with the answer
page.intro: A skill for coding agents. Edit, choose or adjust inside the conversation, then let the agent continue from what you changed.
page.chooseRequest: “Show me two ways to present my study plan.”
page.adjustRequest: “Fit this study session into the time I have.”
page.choiceIdle: Choose the view you would use.
page.choiceFocus: Focus on the next task. The rest stays out of the way.
page.choiceOverview: See how the whole session fits together.
page.planIdle: Adjust the time to see the whole plan change.
page.note: These examples update sample content on this page. They run locally without a model. Inside a supported chat host, the same handoff sends your action to the ongoing conversation.
page.chatBody: Some answers need a sentence. Others benefit from a view you can work with. Show me asks the agent to choose for the task, carry your edits forward, and let you keep talking.
page.agentBody: Copy the skill folder into your agent’s skill directory. The included editable-answer example uses Codex’s conversation API; other hosts use their documented renderer and follow-up tools.

editor.label: Project description
editor.noScript: You can describe the change in the chat.
editor.idleDemo: Edit the wording, then use it to update the sample below.
editor.idleChat: Edit here, or keep talking in the chat. Use this sends your wording to the agent.
editor.unavailable: Continue in the chat to use these edits. This preview has no connection to an agent.
editor.tooLarge: This draft is too large to restore later. Keep this view open until you send it.
editor.saveFailed: Draft recovery is unavailable. Your text is still here; keep this view open.
editor.restoredSent: This view already handed off a response. Check the chat for its outcome.
editor.restoredUnknown: An earlier send has no confirmed outcome. Check the chat before sending again.
editor.restored: Your draft is back. Keep editing or use it.
editor.draft: Your draft is ready when you are.
editor.suggestion: A starting point. Change any words you like.
editor.invalid: This text could not be checked. Shorten it or reopen the current result.
editor.sendingChat: Handing your edits to the chat.
editor.cancelled: Nothing sent. Your draft is still here.
editor.doneDemo: Sample updated with your exact wording. This page runs locally without an agent.
editor.doneChat: Handed to the chat. The agent will report what it changed there.
editor.failedDemo: The sample could not be updated. Your wording is still here.
editor.failedChat: Delivery could not be confirmed. Your draft is here. Check the chat before sending again.

sample.value: Trail notes is an application that allows people to record walking routes and add notes about places along the way.
sample.suggestion: Trail notes helps you record walks and remember places along the way.

page.title: Show me：在对话里直接修改结果
page.description: Show me 帮助编程助手在对话中展示可操作的内容，再根据你的修改继续完成任务。
page.heading: 在对话里直接改
page.intro: 给编程助手用的 skill。你在对话里改文字、选方案、调参数，助手接着完成任务。
page.chooseRequest: “给我看看学习计划的两种布局。”
page.adjustRequest: “按我有的时间，调整这次学习安排。”
page.focusTime: 先做 20 分钟，再简单回顾
page.choiceIdle: 选一个你用着顺手的布局。
page.choiceFocus: 先看眼前这一项，其他安排暂时收起。
page.choiceOverview: 一次看清整个学习安排。
page.planIdle: 调一下时间，看看每一项怎么变。
page.planSaved: 示例已采用 {value} 分钟的安排。
page.note: 这里的操作只会更新网页里的示例内容，不调用模型。在支持回传的聊天应用里，点击采用会把修改交回当前对话。
page.chatBody: 有些问题，一句话就能说清。有些内容，直接改起来更方便。Show me 让助手按当前任务选择合适的形式，接住你的修改，也接住你接着说的话。
page.agentBody: 把 skill 文件夹复制到助手的 skill 目录。随包提供的文字编辑示例使用 Codex 的对话接口；其他应用按各自文档中的显示和回传接口接入。
page.batch: 批量文字处理示例（英文）

editor.label: 项目介绍
editor.region: 直接修改当前这段文字
editor.noScript: 也可以直接在聊天里说明要怎么改。
editor.idleDemo: 改好后点击采用，下面的示例就会更新。
editor.idleChat: 可以直接改这里，也可以接着聊。点击采用后，修改会交给助手。
editor.unavailable: 这个预览暂时没有连上助手，可以在聊天里告诉助手怎么改。
editor.tooLarge: 这段草稿太长，暂时存不下。提交前请先保留这个编辑区。
editor.saveFailed: 暂时无法保存草稿，文字还在这里，先别关闭编辑区。
editor.restoredSent: 这份修改已经交回对话，处理结果会在聊天里回复。
editor.restoredUnknown: 上一次提交还没确认结果，先看一下聊天里的回复。
editor.restored: 你的草稿还在，可以接着改。
editor.draft: 先慢慢改，采用后再提交。
editor.suggestion: 换了一种短一点的说法，你可以继续改。
editor.empty: 先写点内容，再点击采用。
editor.invalid: 这段文字未能通过检查，请缩短一点，或重新打开当前内容。
editor.doneDemo: 示例已按你的原话更新。这个网页在本地运行，没有连接助手。
editor.doneChat: 已交回对话，助手会回复实际处理结果。
editor.failedDemo: 示例没有更新成功，文字还在。
editor.failedChat: 暂时无法确认有没有送达，草稿还在。先看一下聊天里的回复，再决定是否重试。
editor.editingAgain: 可以继续修改刚刚采用的内容。

sample.value: 步行笔记是一个应用，可以让你记录步行路线，并为沿途经过的地点添加笔记。
sample.suggestion: 用步行笔记记录路线，记下沿途值得回看的地方。
